about: Pack on a ledge below the route. Target selection matched a bottom-of-ledge mob to an early top leg of the route in 2D, and IsLevelReachable accepted any PATHFIND_NORMAL path however long. The tank on the ledge picked mobs whose real walk was a long ramp detour, or had no path at all. Fixed in e4d002da: corridor legs carry Z (DC_CORRIDOR_Z_BAND) and a detour-ratio gate (DC_TRASH_DETOUR_RATIO/SLACK) applies. Staged from a real Stratholme pull taken from 10.5yd above the pack at 37yd (tr-20260922-192701-27#24, with the same layout in -190510-14#23 and -200558-45#25). The patrolling Crimson Gallant that joined that pull is left out, so only the ledge decides.
